description: A database maintained by the U.S.
title: What Works Clearinghouse (WWC) database of reviewed studies

description: A large publicly released dataset of responses to the WhichEnglish online English grammar quiz, created by Hartshorne and colleagues to study syntactic knowledge across ages, language backgrounds, and English exposure.
title: WhichEnglish internet grammar quiz dataset (669,498 speakers)

description: A WHO-developed, on-site participatory coaching programme that trains healthcare workers in essential newborn care and neonatal resuscitation through demonstration, discussion, peer feedback, repeated practice, and checklist-based assessment.
title: WHO Early Essential Newborn Care (EENC) 2-day participatory coaching program

description: A WHO-standardized assessment and training framework using verified malaria blood-smear panels to evaluate and develop microscopists’ diagnostic competency.
title: WHO External Competency Assessment of Malaria Microscopists (ECAMM) framework

description: A WHO service-delivery framework that organizes screening, first-level intervention, treatment, and specialist referral for perinatal mental health across primary, community, and specialist care providers.
title: WHO framework for integrating perinatal mental health into maternal and child health services

description: A World Health Organization framework for improving student health and well-being by integrating health into the curriculum, school ethos and environment, and family and community engagement.
title: WHO Health Promoting Schools (HPS) framework

description: A self-administered Google Forms questionnaire developed by Neupane Harish Chandra et al.
title: WHO-referenced online Google Forms KAP questionnaire

description: A World Health Organization framework that structures rational drug prescribing into six steps for use in clinical practice and undergraduate medical education.
title: WHO six-step normative model of rational prescribing

description: A framework for organizing education around developmental relationships, supportive environments, rich learning, skill and mindset development, and integrated supports, developed from the science of learning and development literature.
title: Whole Child Approach

description: A district-facing framework and facilitated planning guide for aligning whole-person education initiatives, developed for adoption by education systems.
title: Whole-Person Education Guide

description: A Chicago Public Schools framework developed with community-based organizations that organizes school safety planning around physical safety, emotional safety, and relational trust.
title: Whole School Safety (WSS) Framework

description: A Centers for Disease Control and Prevention framework that organizes coordinated school health and education efforts across 10 components to support K–12 students' health, learning, and development.
title: Whole School, Whole Community, Whole Child (WSCC) model
